training_reference.stage_transfer: Selected compatible pretrained actor; fresh critic and optimizer, fixed 3e-5 and 50 critic warmup updates in every trained stage
training_reference.initial_acceptance: Skip nominal stand training only if the transferred actor passes both original fixed evaluation seeds; all subsequent gates remain mandatory
training_reference.recovery: Actor transfer across changed task distributions; optimizer resume only within the identical materialized stage contract
training_reference.provenance: The launch receipt must identify the selected checkpoint path, SHA, source updates and fixed comparison results; this is not scratch training
